verdict.rationale: Alloy is an identity, fraud and AML platform, so preparing a suspicious-activity report is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows adjacent capabilities: transaction monitoring that "generate[s] alerts or investigations" and Investigations as a case concept. Nothing documents preparing a SAR, let alone a jurisdiction-specific one assembled from case evidence.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can prepare a jurisdiction-specific suspicious-activity report from case evidence
